mentions.name: On-prem multi-region KaaS/VMaaS platform
mentions.description: An internal enterprise platform providing totally on-premises, multi-AZ, multi-region Kubernetes-as-a-Service and VM-as-a-Service, with Database-as-a-Service planned next along with some other managed services, built with everything git-driven to satisfy internal policies.
mentions.problem: Building on-prem multi-AZ, multi-region cloud services is much harder than initially planned, and internal policies that require everything to be git-driven make it worse.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been building the same thing at $enterprise, totally on-prem multi-AZ, multi-region KaaS, VMaaS, and soon DBaaS, and some of the other services listed. It’s a great deal harder than we initially planned for and we have some ridiculous internal policies that require everything to be git-driven which makes it worse.
mentions.author: stroebs
